title: Reading lab: Ephesians 1:3–6
subtitle: Handle a long blessing sentence without losing its main claim.
overview: Ephesians 1 opens with a long blessing sentence full of prepositional phrases, participial material, and purpose language. Locate the blessing before attaching modifiers.
A long sentence should be mapped in layers: main declaration, divine action, sphere, and purpose—not translated word by word in order.

items.grc: εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
items.en: Blessed is the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

items.grc: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους.
items.en: Just as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world to be holy.
